Foundation Implementation Plan ​

For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Add new DB models (Backup, NewsCache), user profile settings keys, .env loading, ai.py utility, and new router stubs (retirement, taxes, news, backups) so all subsequent plans have a stable foundation to build on.

Architecture: Extend models.py with two new tables, add python-dotenv for .env loading, create a central ai.py wrapper for the Claude API, rename the projections router to retirement, and stub out three new routers. All new routers return placeholder responses until their respective plans implement them.

Tech Stack: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, SQLite, python-dotenv, anthropic SDK

# backend/tests/conftest.py
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from backend.database import Base, get_db
from backend.main import app

TEST_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test.db"

engine = create_engine(TEST_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def setup_db():
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    yield
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)


@pytest.fixture
def db():
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield session
    finally:
        session.close()


@pytest.fixture
def client(db):
    def override_get_db():
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            pass
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        yield c
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

class Backup(Base):
    __tablename__ = "backups"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, server_default=func.now())
    label = Column(Text, nullable=False)
    file_path = Column(Text, nullable=False)
    size_bytes = Column(Integer, default=0)


class NewsCache(Base):
    __tablename__ = "news_cache"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    fetched_at = Column(DateTime, server_default=func.now())
    source = Column(Text, nullable=False)  # rss | newsapi
    title = Column(Text, nullable=False)
    url = Column(Text, nullable=False)
    published_at = Column(DateTime)
    symbols = Column(JSON, default=list)
    categories = Column(JSON, default=list)

import os
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import pytest


def test_is_configured_false_when_no_key():
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
        from backend.ai import is_configured
        assert is_configured() is False


def test_is_configured_true_when_key_present():
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {"CLAUDE_API_KEY": "sk-test"}):
        # Re-import to pick up env change
        import importlib
        import backend.ai as ai_module
        importlib.reload(ai_module)
        assert ai_module.is_configured() is True


def test_chat_raises_when_not_configured():
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
        import importlib
        import backend.ai as ai_module
        importlib.reload(ai_module)
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="CLAUDE_API_KEY"):
            ai_module.chat("hello", context={})

  • [ ] Step 4: Create ai.py
python
# backend/ai.py
import os
from typing import Any


def is_configured() -> bool:
    return bool(os.getenv("CLAUDE_API_KEY"))


def chat(prompt: str, context: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Send a prompt to Claude with financial context. Raises if not configured."""
    api_key = os.getenv("CLAUDE_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError("CLAUDE_API_KEY not set in .env")

    import anthropic
    client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=api_key)

    system = (
        "You are a personal finance assistant for Libertas. "
        "The user's financial data is provided as context. "
        "Give specific, actionable advice. Be concise. "
        f"User profile: {context.get('profile', {})}. "
        f"Portfolio summary: {context.get('portfolio', {})}."
    )

    message = client.messages.create(
        model="claude-sonnet-4-6",
        max_tokens=1024,
        system=system,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
    )
    return message.content[0].text
